items.issue: The video makes identifiable-person claims about marriage motives, attraction, debt, business conduct and family beneficiaries without supplying primary records or full responses.
items.disposition: Attribute every claim to Mikey, keep it unverified, and do not present it as fact about the named people.

items.issue: The alleged contract routing, asset transfer and tax effect are high-impact financial/legal assertions.
items.disposition: Require contracts, corporate records, accounts, tax/legal analysis and responses before any factual use; otherwise keep do_not_generalize.

items.issue: The video treats edited interviews and public clips as evidence of hidden motives and a coordinated public-relations strategy.
items.disposition: Do not infer intent from montage selections; targeted continuous review at 0-75 and 500-640 seconds would still not substitute for external verification.

items.issue: Broad evolutionary and gender claims are stated as biological facts without methods or sources.
items.disposition: Keep as Mikey's model only; do not generalize to women, relationships or named individuals.

items.issue: Advice about retaining the ability to replace or leave a partner can be turned into coercive leverage rather than healthy autonomy.
items.disposition: Do not convert into action advice; if later used, separate financial autonomy and boundaries from threats or dominance.

items.issue: The same case and many underlying claims overlap formal source S-cMTEvo6To and video-012, but repetition is not corroboration.
items.disposition: Count this upload as a distinct scripted source only; assign no extra confidence to repeated allegations.

items.issue: Automatic ASR repeatedly corrupts names, terms and idioms, including the public figures' names, '慕强', '沉没成本' and closing phrases.
items.disposition: Normalize only where context is unambiguous; listen to original audio before quoting exact wording.
